author: val
body: Bytes 0 to 63 are the desk's: the window registry keeps a window's slot at cells 44 through 60 of whatever block `desk-wnd-blk` answers, so the service's cells start at 64.

author: fester
body: An explicit child heap keeps networking allocations and compaction separate from the desk's per-event heap reclamation. The 8 MiB budget is passed to process-spawn-with-heap by gopweb-start.
